shadcn_brief_generate_ui.failure: Fails when upstream model call fails or returns empty text.

shadcn_brief_refine_ui.failure: Fails when input schema validation or model call fails.

shadcn_brief_convert_react_shadcn.success: Returns JSON with files array and optional notes.
shadcn_brief_convert_react_shadcn.failure: Fails on invalid JSON, schema mismatch, or unsafe output path.

shadcn_brief_make_react_page.success: Returns JSON payload with html, files, notes, and detection metadata.
shadcn_brief_make_react_page.failure: Fails if generate/convert stage fails or output validation fails.

shadcn_brief_apply_files.success: Returns apply plan/written summary and supports rollback details.
shadcn_brief_apply_files.failure: Fails on path traversal, write errors, or rollback failure.

shadcn_brief_embed_content.success: Returns embedding vectors and provider metadata.
shadcn_brief_embed_content.failure: Fails when embedding provider rejects request or returns invalid shape.

shadcn_brief_rag_upsert.success: Returns inserted document count and index metadata.
shadcn_brief_rag_upsert.failure: Fails on invalid document schema or embedding/index errors.

shadcn_brief_rag_search.failure: Fails on retrieval pipeline errors or invalid search payload.

shadcn_brief_observe_screen.success: Returns observation output from computer-use model path.
shadcn_brief_observe_screen.failure: Fails when multimodal payload is invalid or provider call fails.

shadcn_brief_execute_ui_action.success: Returns action execution result and risk metadata.
shadcn_brief_execute_ui_action.failure: Fails when high-risk action misses confirmation or action schema is invalid.

shadcn_brief_computer_use_loop.success: Returns observe-plan-act loop result with safety decisions.
shadcn_brief_computer_use_loop.failure: Fails on invalid planned action contract or provider-side execution error.

shadcn_brief_review_uiux.success: Returns structured UI/UX heuristic review payload.
shadcn_brief_review_uiux.failure: Fails on schema validation errors or model scoring errors.

shadcn_brief_quality_gate.failure: Fails in strict mode when command policy or validation checks fail.

shadcn_brief_scan_workspace_profile.success: Returns workspace profile with routes, components, tokens, and framework hints.
shadcn_brief_scan_workspace_profile.failure: Fails when the workspace root is invalid or profile scan inputs are unreadable.

shadcn_brief_plan_change.success: Returns a structured change plan with touched files, risks, and optional artifact output.
shadcn_brief_plan_change.failure: Fails when planning inputs are invalid or workspace/profile analysis cannot be completed.

shadcn_brief_build_acceptance_pack.success: Returns an acceptance pack with criteria, assertions, and optional evaluation output.
shadcn_brief_build_acceptance_pack.failure: Fails when acceptance inputs are invalid or acceptance pack construction/evaluation fails.

shadcn_brief_build_review_bundle.success: Returns a review bundle with summary, artifacts, and optional markdown output.
shadcn_brief_build_review_bundle.failure: Fails when bundle inputs are invalid or acceptance/review artifact generation fails.

shadcn_brief_repo_workflow_summary.success: Returns a read-only repo workflow snapshot with local git state, GitHub checks, alert counts, and recent failed runs.
shadcn_brief_repo_workflow_summary.failure: Fails when the workspace root is invalid or GitHub connectivity/read operations cannot be completed.

shadcn_brief_ship_feature_flow.success: Returns a feature-flow delivery payload with plan, artifacts, and gated execution summary.
shadcn_brief_ship_feature_flow.failure: Fails when feature-flow schema is invalid or any required planning/shipping stage fails.

shadcn_brief_next_smoke.failure: Fails when Next.js install/build/start/probe stages fail.

shadcn_brief_ship_react_page.success: Returns end-to-end payload with steps and summary status.
shadcn_brief_ship_react_page.failure: Fails when any required stage (generate/convert/apply/quality_gate) fails.

shadcn_brief_detect_shadcn_paths.failure: Fails when workspace path is invalid or detection inputs are unreadable.

shadcn_brief_list_models.failure: Fails when Gemini sidecar list_models call fails.
